# apicp_account_stats (Data Source)

Reads resource counts for an `apicp_account` (web domains, databases, mail domains/mailboxes, cron jobs, sub-accounts) - a plain tally, nothing configurable here, hence a data source rather than a resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apicp_account_stats" "example" {
  account_id = apicp_account.example.id
}

output "example_web_domains" {
  value = data.apicp_account_stats.example.web_domains
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) ID of the `apicp_account` to read stats for.

### Read-Only

- `cron_jobs` (Number)
- `databases` (Number)
- `mail_domains` (Number)
- `mailboxes` (Number)
- `sub_accounts` (Number)
- `web_domains` (Number)
